summary: Verified fixes for (1) re-login with active license and (2) share permission denied. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass including 5 new /api/license/login tests (correct, wrong email, unactivated code -> 401, deactivated -> 403, case-insensitive) and 3 share tests (auth required, 404 unknown ditar, 404 unknown token). Frontend (Playwright, 1 AI generation used): created license via admin, activated via 'aktivizo' tab, generated 1 ditar (~15-25s), ditar-share-btn label transitioned 'Ndaj...' -> 'Ndaj' within <5s, clicking share did NOT raise permission-denied/toast errors (no page errors; sonner only showed 'Ditari u gjenerua'), Shkarko Word download fired docx, logout returned to login screen with 'hyr' tab default and reg-email + reg-kodi correctly prefilled (reg-emri NOT rendered on hyr tab), relogin via 'Hyr' succeeded. Public GET /api/share/{token} returned 200 with correct Content-Type (vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), Content-Disposition attachment filename, 37KB payload, PK zip signature confirming valid .docx. Created test license was cleaned up (DELETE). Leftover license ASCAP-GC8LLH-7931 from an aborted mid-test was also deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginScreen: Hydration warning in console - AdminModal <option> contains a <span> wrapper injected by VE instrumentation; harmless dev-only noise, not a product bug.
DitarModal.prepare: silently swallows errors (`catch {}`). If /ditar/{id}/share repeatedly fails, user sees 'Ndaj...' forever with no feedback. Consider surfacing via toast after N retries.
LicLogin uses body.email case-insensitively but admin-stored email was already lowercased; verified case-insensitive login works.
/api/share/{token} is unauthenticated by design (public share link). Token is a 32-char hex uuid, so brute-force risk is low; no rate limiting - acceptable for MVP.
DitarModal.share: fallback window.open on AbortError also opens wa.me - user cancelling native share now opens WhatsApp which may be unexpected (minor UX).
test_credentials: Admin X-Admin-Password: artikleo. UI test created & deleted ephemeral license (cleaned up).
seed_data_creation: One ditar persisted temporarily on an ephemeral license, deleted via cascade when the test license was removed. Real license ASCAP-QKGAWN-1690 untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI generation consumed 1 credit (user has low credits - keep future tests to 0-1 generations). pytest.ini forces xdist; run tests with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -o addopts='' --junitxml=...` to disable xdist for module-scoped license fixture. New /api/license/login endpoint is case-insensitive on both kodi (upper) and email (lower).
